# Balaji Rajaram

> B2B Technology Marketing professional with 12+ years of experience in demand generation, digital growth, technical SEO, and AI-driven search optimization (GEO/AEO) for IT services and technology companies. Currently Senior Marketing Executive at Chimera Technologies, Bangalore.

Balaji Rajaram specializes in integrated B2B marketing, website transformation, SEO strategy, and optimizing digital content for discoverability by AI search engines and large language models (Generative Engine Optimization / Answer Engine Optimization). He has led measurable growth including 3X organic traffic, 2X inbound leads, and LinkedIn community growth from 300 to 31,000+ followers.

## Core Expertise

- Technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, internal linking, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, structured data/schema, Core Web Vitals, site migrations.
- SEO Strategy & Analytics: keyword and search-intent research, competitor analysis, Google Search Console, GA4, GTM, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse.
- AI Search (GEO/AEO): Generative Engine Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization, LLM discoverability, AI-assisted SEO workflows, prompt engineering.
- Demand Generation: integrated campaigns, digital growth, customer acquisition, sales enablement, conversion-focused experiences.
- Content & Messaging: thought leadership, solution narratives, landing pages, case studies, executive communications.
- Leadership: SEO team mentoring, cross-functional coordination with developers, designers, and content teams.
